criticalStopCondition: A critical_stop requirement with status fail or error blocks any readiness claim. Critical stops cannot be averaged away, offset by passes elsewhere, or waived by static-check success, filename matching, or browser preview.

requirements.evidenceExpected: Declared canonical entry file plus canonical source list; no claim that a bundle or export is the source.
requirements.limitations: Scanner cannot prove authorship or ownership intent; it can only report declared entry points, duplicate candidate roots, and bundle-like artifacts. Human confirms the declaration.
requirements.requirement: The candidate must declare one canonical editable entry and its canonical source files; generated bundles and exports must not be presented as canonical sources.

requirements.evidenceExpected: Manifest parse result and referenced-file list from the scanner report.
requirements.limitations: Parseability is not packaging validity and not LMS proof.
requirements.requirement: When imsmanifest.xml is present it must be well-formed XML with resolvable resource references.

requirements.evidenceExpected: Scanner broken-local-reference list is empty for referenced HTML/CSS assets.
requirements.limitations: Static reference resolution only; does not prove rendered or LMS-served correctness.
requirements.requirement: All local HTML/CSS asset references must resolve to files present in the candidate.

requirements.evidenceExpected: Scanner decoding table shows every HTML file decoded as UTF-8 or UTF-16 with no undecodable files.
requirements.limitations: Decodability is not correctness of the encoded mathematics or text.
requirements.requirement: Every HTML file must decode as UTF-8 or UTF-16; undecodable files are defects.

requirements.evidenceExpected: Scanner reports no absolute or traversal member paths.
requirements.limitations: Static member-name inspection only.
requirements.requirement: Archive members must not use absolute paths or parent-directory traversal.

requirements.evidenceExpected: Teacher/reviewer walkthrough confirming the order instruction, attempted step, useful feedback, repair, fresh attempt, independent evidence exists without relying on the exact labels Learn, Practise, Show what you know.
requirements.limitations: The scanner reports keyword evidence only (LEARNER_FLOW); sequence and pedagogical quality require human review of rendered content.
requirements.requirement: The learner flow must follow instruction, attempted step, useful feedback, repair, fresh attempt, then independent evidence; the exact labels Learn, Practise, and Show what you know are proposals, not mandatory strings.

requirements.evidenceExpected: Scanner keyword-evidence table for all five flow stages.
requirements.limitations: Keyword presence is not proof of a working sequence; absence may be vocabulary mismatch rather than a missing stage.
requirements.requirement: Static keyword evidence for each flow stage (instruction, attempted work, feedback/repair, fresh attempt, independent evidence) must be present as a triage signal.

requirements.dimension: mathematical checker contract and unsupported cases
requirements.evidenceExpected: Independent mathematical derivation by a qualified reviewer, separate from any scanner output or browser preview.
requirements.limitations: The scanner must never certify mathematical correctness; parseability and keyword signals are not validation.
requirements.requirement: Mathematical correctness must be established by independent derivation, never by the static scanner, filename matching, or preview appearance.

requirements.dimension: mathematical checker contract and unsupported cases
requirements.evidenceExpected: Reviewer checklist distinguishing the six aspects on sample items, plus a list of items the checker declines.
requirements.limitations: Static checks cannot evaluate equivalence, domain, form, units, or reasoning.
requirements.requirement: Checking must distinguish parseability, equivalence, domain and restrictions, requested form, units and rounding, and reasoning evidence, and must explicitly decline unsupported cases instead of guessing.

requirements.evidenceExpected: Scanner placeholder table; reviewer confirms each hit is either removed or a legitimate learner-facing word.
requirements.limitations: Heuristic wordlist; low-confidence wording required, false positives expected (for example legitimate classroom use of the word TODO-free 'draft' in prose).
requirements.requirement: Obvious unfinished placeholders, internal repair notes, and developer-only language must be flagged and cleared before readiness.

requirements.evidenceExpected: Reviewer traceability table mapping candidate items to source IDs, equation/diagram assets, manifest descriptions, question relationships, and scanned worked examples.
requirements.limitations: Static inventory lists files and references; it cannot confirm fidelity to original pedagogy.
requirements.requirement: Source traceability, original IDs, equation and diagram assets, manifest descriptions, question relationships, and scanned worked examples must be preserved from import through packaging.

requirements.evidenceExpected: Scanner external-dependency list reviewed; every runtime-critical dependency is vendored or has an approved offline fallback.
requirements.limitations: Static URL extraction only; cannot determine whether a dependency is actually fetched at runtime or whether the CDN is reachable from the LMS.
requirements.requirement: External runtime dependencies that would break offline or LMS-served use must be vendored or given an approved fallback; undeclared CDN reliance is a stop condition.

requirements.evidenceExpected: Scanner missing-media list is empty.
requirements.limitations: Presence is not playability; codec, size, and LMS-serving behaviour need live proof.
requirements.requirement: Essential referenced media (audio, video, documents) must be present in the candidate, not just referenced.

requirements.dimension: stable IDs, seeds, versions, and resume compatibility
requirements.evidenceExpected: Scanner duplicate-ID list is empty; interaction and save identifiers are reported present.
requirements.limitations: Uniqueness of id attributes is checkable; semantic stability across versions requires human versioning discipline.
requirements.requirement: Interaction and save identifiers must be present and unique; duplicate element IDs are defects.

requirements.dimension: stable IDs, seeds, versions, and resume compatibility
requirements.evidenceExpected: Version/seed manifest or reviewer record showing seeded items regenerate identically and saved progress resumes across a version bump.
requirements.limitations: The scanner reports identifier and version-marker evidence only; resume behaviour needs a live session test.
requirements.requirement: Seeded or versioned content must reproduce deterministically and saved progress must resume compatibly across declared versions.

requirements.evidenceExpected: Scanner SCORM/save/completion marker table treated as inspection-only signals.
requirements.limitations: Marker presence is not proof of working save, commit, or reported completion.
requirements.requirement: SCORM, save, and completion markers must be inventoried as inspection-only signals, never as proof of persistence or reporting.

requirements.evidenceExpected: Scanner storage-key and suspend-data evidence table.
requirements.limitations: Static evidence only; actual byte budget against suspend_data limits needs runtime measurement.
requirements.requirement: State keys and suspend-data usage must be visible so state-budget risk can be assessed; hidden or second save systems are forbidden.

requirements.evidenceExpected: Live session test record: interrupted session resumes, progress persists, and reported completion matches actual learner state.
requirements.limitations: No static check can prove save/reporting truthfulness.
requirements.requirement: Saved answers, progress, and reported completion must truthfully reflect learner state under interruption and resume; reuse Canvas Helper state foundations rather than a second save system.

requirements.evidenceExpected: Reviewer map of teacher-editable surfaces to canonical source files plus a successful deterministic rebuild record.
requirements.limitations: The scanner can list editable-looking markers but cannot prove edit safety or rebuild determinism.
requirements.requirement: Teacher-editable content and deterministic rebuild/override ownership must be explicit: every editable surface maps to a canonical file and rebuilds deterministically.

requirements.evidenceExpected: Scanner secret-indicator list is empty or every hit is reviewed and cleared; matched contents are never printed.
requirements.limitations: Keyword and filename heuristics only; cannot detect obfuscated secrets and must not print matched content.
requirements.requirement: No formal-assessment secret or answer key may ship inside the ordinary formative client package; any indicator is a stop until reviewed.

requirements.evidenceExpected: Reviewer record confirming practice items are formative variants and formal exams plus answer secrets live outside the client package.
requirements.limitations: Requires human judgment about item provenance; static separation signals are insufficient.
requirements.requirement: Practice must remain formative and variant-based while formal exams and answer secrets stay outside the client package; Brightspace remains the formal-assessment environment.

requirements.dimension: notation, keyboard, graph alternatives, mobile, and accessibility
requirements.evidenceExpected: Scanner document language/title table.
requirements.limitations: Presence indicators only, not accessibility certification.
requirements.requirement: Every HTML document must declare a language and a non-empty title.

requirements.dimension: notation, keyboard, graph alternatives, mobile, and accessibility
requirements.evidenceExpected: Scanner images-without-alt list reviewed for meaningful alternatives, especially graphs and diagrams.
requirements.limitations: Heuristic indicator only; meaningfulness of alt text and graph alternatives needs human review, never scanner certification.
requirements.requirement: Images, especially graphs and diagrams, must carry meaningful text alternatives; missing alt is an indicator requiring review.

requirements.dimension: notation, keyboard, graph alternatives, mobile, and accessibility
requirements.evidenceExpected: Scanner unlabeled-control list is empty or each control is shown to have an evident label through a path the scanner cannot see.
requirements.limitations: Label-association heuristics miss dynamic or ARIA-complex labelling; human assistive-technology check is still required.
requirements.requirement: Form controls, including math input and keyboard entry paths, must have an evident label; unlabeled controls are a stop until cleared.

requirements.dimension: notation, keyboard, graph alternatives, mobile, and accessibility
requirements.evidenceExpected: Reviewer record covering keyboard-only operation, graph non-visual alternatives, notation entry, and a small-screen pass.
requirements.limitations: No static check can certify keyboard operability, mobile usability, or accessibility conformance.
requirements.requirement: Keyboard operation, graph alternatives, math notation entry, and mobile layout must be human-verified; static indicators never count as certification.

requirements.dimension: factoring pilot completeness and trig contrast coverage
requirements.evidenceExpected: Scanner factoring-evidence table showing deep slice coverage.
requirements.limitations: Keyword content indicators only, never mathematical validation or completeness proof.
requirements.requirement: The pilot must show a deep Math 10C factoring slice as content indicators; keyword absence triggers manual review, not automatic failure of scope.

requirements.dimension: factoring pilot completeness and trig contrast coverage
requirements.evidenceExpected: Scanner trig-evidence table plus reviewer confirmation that trigonometry is a smaller contrast, not a second full course.
requirements.limitations: Keyword indicators only; scope judgment needs a human.
requirements.requirement: Right-triangle trigonometry must appear as a smaller contrast to the factoring slice; scope creep toward additional full courses is a stop.

requirements.dimension: factoring pilot completeness and trig contrast coverage
requirements.evidenceExpected: Fixture files or reviewer note reserving 20-1/30-1 compatibility without building those courses.
requirements.limitations: Out of scope for the static scanner; tracked as a planning reservation.
requirements.requirement: Later 20-1/30-1 compatibility must be reserved through fixtures or notes, not built as additional courses in this pilot.

requirements.evidenceExpected: Separate local-alignment verdict and repository/LMS-readiness verdict in the audit report; no readiness claim without the second.
requirements.limitations: The scanner and report template can enforce separate verdict fields but cannot perform LMS proof.
requirements.requirement: Local artifact alignment and complete repository/LMS readiness must carry separate verdicts; passing static checks or a browser preview must never be presented as LMS proof, teacher acceptance, or release readiness.

requirements.evidenceExpected: Integration record showing reuse of Canvas Helper ownership, authoring, state, and SCORM foundations with no second save system, universal CAS, handwriting recognition, hidden runtime AI, cross-course analytics, or single-giant-SCO design.
requirements.limitations: Architectural judgment; static markers are supporting evidence only.
requirements.requirement: The candidate must reuse Canvas Helper ownership, authoring, state, and SCORM foundations without introducing a second save system, universal CAS, handwriting recognition, hidden runtime AI, a cross-course analytics service, or one giant SCO.

requirements.evidenceExpected: Gate checklist in the audit report with each external authority marked accepted, waived by its owner, or blocking.
requirements.limitations: Gate outcomes arrive from people and institutions outside this harness.
requirements.requirement: Current curriculum rules, calculator and assessment rules, redistribution permissions, accommodations, and Brightspace tenant behaviour must each pass their external authority gate, with Brightspace as course home and teacher-contact layer and Canvas Helper as authoring, integration, and packaging environment.

requirements.evidenceExpected: Scanner reports no duplicate or case-colliding member names and no corrupt members.
requirements.limitations: Name-level integrity only; does not validate content.
requirements.requirement: The candidate archive must contain no corrupt members and no duplicate or case-colliding names that would silently overwrite on case-insensitive filesystems.

requirements.evidenceExpected: Reviewer walkthrough showing that learners can retain a written attempt, act on feedback, record a self-correction, and preserve selected evidence, while supported practice and independent evidence remain visibly distinct.
requirements.limitations: Static inspection cannot establish whether the learner experience preserves authentic work or whether reported mastery comes from an independent attempt.
requirements.requirement: The candidate must preserve learner-written attempts, feedback-informed self-correction, and selected evidence without replacing the original attempt or counting supported practice as independent mastery.

schemaDoc.automatedCheck: Stable scanner check id covering this requirement, or null when only human review can decide.
schemaDoc.criticality: critical_stop blocks any readiness claim on fail/error; required must pass or be waived with a recorded reason; recommended is advisory.
schemaDoc.dimension: One of the twelve required audit dimensions.
schemaDoc.evidenceExpected: What a reviewer must attach to move status off not_evaluated.
schemaDoc.id: Stable row id MATH10C-REQ-NNN; never reused or renumbered.
schemaDoc.limitations: Why the automated check (or human review) is insufficient on its own.
schemaDoc.requirement: One atomic, auditable statement; no invented curriculum outcomes.
schemaDoc.stage: Pipeline stage: import, normalize, edit, expand, integrate, or export.
schemaDoc.status: Initial value not_evaluated; later pass, fail, manual_review, not_applicable, or error.
